editor_note: All four rewritten entries (33, 63, 64, 66) keep the English meaning. Nothing drifts, nothing is added and no caveat is lost. 'utility-grade performance' → 'desempenho em escala de utilidade quântica' and 'contributed by' → 'fornecidas por' are acceptable choices. The one thing to fix is at the end of entry 64: 'experimentar mais facilmente incorporar a computação quântica' puts an infinitive straight after 'experimentar', which reads like a calque of the English. A native editor would turn it into a noun phrase ('experimentar com mais facilidade a incorporação da computação quântica').

examples.source: so they can more easily experiment with plugging quantum into their domain-specific workflows
examples.translation: para que possam experimentar mais facilmente incorporar a computação quântica em seus fluxos de trabalho específicos de domínio
examples.suggested: para que possam experimentar com mais facilidade a incorporação da computação quântica em seus fluxos de trabalho específicos de domínio
examples.why: In 'experimentar ... incorporar', an infinitive follows 'experimentar' directly. That is awkward, calqued syntax. A noun phrase reads naturally and keeps the meaning.

editor_note: Faithful and natural across all five entries, with "skills" rendered consistently as "habilidades do Qiskit" and the release in [5] kept accurate ("A habilidade migrate-qiskit-ibm-runtime foi lançada, para migrar código qiskit-ibm-runtime").

The meaning holds throughout. Dates, repetition-delay ranges, "no sooner than" in [287] and the caveats on the exploratory QPUs all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The problems are consistency. "Gate" is kept in English in the 2026 entries ([17], [29], [86], [122]) but becomes "porta(s)" from [178] on ([180], [258], [272], [277], [280]). Retirement is "aposentado/aposentadas" in [92]–[98] and [107] but "desativado/desativada" in [148], [152], [175]–[176] and [180]. Six month headings are left in English ("July 2026", "May 2026", "April 2026", "March 2026", "February 2026", "January 2026" in [38]–[112]), while [7] and [13] give "setembro de 2026" and "agosto de 2026". There are also small grammar slips: workload switches gender ("as workloads" in [46] vs "workloads mais complexos" in [118]), "Corrigido sessões" in [217]/[218] has the wrong agreement, and "alguns QPUs" in [162] clashes with the feminine "as QPUs" used everywhere else.

examples.source: July 2026 {#july-2026}
examples.translation: July 2026 {#july-2026}
examples.suggested: julho de 2026 {#july-2026}
examples.why: Heading left in English, while [7] and [13] give 'setembro de 2026' and 'agosto de 2026'. The same problem appears in [52], [62], [101], [105] and [112].

examples.source: directly impact coherence, gate fidelity, and readout performance
examples.translation: impactam diretamente a coerência, a fidelidade das portas e o desempenho de leitura
examples.suggested: a fidelidade dos gates
examples.why: Earlier entries ([17], [29], [86], [122]) keep 'gate', and from here on the file switches to 'porta(s)'. Pick one term for the whole page.

examples.source: `ibm_brisbane` has been retired
examples.translation: `ibm_brisbane` foi desativado
examples.suggested: foi aposentado
examples.why: [92]–[98] use 'aposentar' for retiring QPUs, and this entry switches to 'desativar'. Choose one verb.

examples.source: Addressed failed batch sessions for Open Plan users.
examples.translation: Corrigido sessões de batch com falha para usuários do Open Plan.
examples.suggested: Corrigidas as sessões de batch com falha para usuários do Open Plan.
examples.why: The participle does not agree with the feminine plural 'sessões'. [218] has the same error.

examples.source: except some QPUs under the On-Prem Plan
examples.translation: exceto alguns QPUs no On-Prem Plan
examples.suggested: exceto algumas QPUs no On-Prem Plan
examples.why: QPU is feminine everywhere else in the file ('a QPU', 'as QPUs').

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The key caveats survive intact: the ID-submission step is mandatory, no credit card is needed, and you must create a new account and must not enter your real name in the name fields. The remaining slips are small. "28-day rolling window" is calqued as "janela rotativa de 28 dias" in [3] and [35], where "janela móvel" is the natural Portuguese term. In [29] the English singular "they" becomes the plural "Eles" even though the subject is the singular "O usuário", which breaks agreement. [15] is stiff: "Verifique sua caixa de entrada de e-mail para obter um código".

examples.source: Each instance provides up to 10 minutes of QPU usage per 28-day rolling window.
examples.translation: Cada instância oferece até 10 minutos de uso de QPU por janela rotativa de 28 dias.
examples.suggested: Cada instância oferece até 10 minutos de uso de QPU a cada janela móvel de 28 dias.
examples.why: 'Rotativa' is a calque of 'rolling'. The standard Portuguese term for a sliding time window is 'janela móvel'. The same fix applies to entry [3].

examples.source: The user will receive an invitation ... They will not need to enter credit card information to create their account.
examples.translation: O usuário receberá um convite ... Eles não precisarão inserir informações de cartão de crédito para criar a conta.
examples.suggested: O usuário receberá um convite ... Ele não precisará inserir informações de cartão de crédito para criar a conta.
examples.why: The English singular 'they' was carried over as the plural 'Eles', which does not agree with the singular subject 'O usuário'.

examples.source: Check your email inbox for a seven-digit verification code, then return to the account creation form.
examples.translation: Verifique sua caixa de entrada de e-mail para obter um código de verificação de sete dígitos e, em seguida, retorne ao formulário de criação de conta.
examples.suggested: Procure na sua caixa de entrada o código de verificação de sete dígitos e depois volte ao formulário de criação de conta.
examples.why: The sentence follows English syntax too closely. 'Verificar ... para obter' reads stiffly to a native speaker.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. Core terms are correct and consistent throughout: gate kept in English, registrador, vetor de estados, entrelaçamento, pureza reduzida, estado fundamental. The phase-disk, q-sphere and reduced-purity passages read faithfully. The main slip is in [271] and [275], where "implements the Toffoli gate up to relative phases" becomes "implementa o gate Toffoli com fases relativas". That drops the "a menos de" (up to) sense, even though [214] renders the same idiom correctly as "A menos de uma fase global". Smaller points: [238] strengthens "useful" to "muito útil", [183] has the calque "custa muito mais tempo para ser executado", and in [8] "exibidos" should agree with "o estado" and read "exibido".

examples.source: The simplified Toffoli gate implements the Toffoli gate up to relative phases.
examples.translation: O gate Toffoli simplificado implementa o gate Toffoli com fases relativas.
examples.suggested: O gate Toffoli simplificado implementa o gate Toffoli a menos de fases relativas.
examples.why: 'up to' means 'except for / modulo'. 'com fases relativas' loses that meaning, and it clashes with the correct 'A menos de' used in [214]. The same wording repeats in [275].

examples.source: It is useful for making superpositions.
examples.translation: É muito útil para criar superposições.
examples.suggested: É útil para criar superposições.
examples.why: Adds an intensifier ('muito') that is not in the source, which slightly strengthens the claim.

examples.source: Because the two-qubit CNOT gate costs much more time to execute on real hardware than single qubit gates
examples.translation: Como o gate CNOT de dois qubits custa muito mais tempo para ser executado em hardware real do que os gates de qubit único
examples.suggested: Como o gate CNOT de dois qubits leva muito mais tempo para ser executado em hardware real do que os gates de qubit único
examples.why: 'custa ... tempo' is a calque of 'costs time'. 'leva/demora' is the natural Portuguese verb.

examples.source: the state of qubits, shown as an interactive q-sphere
examples.translation: o estado dos qubits, exibidos como uma q-sphere interativa
examples.suggested: o estado dos qubits, exibido como uma q-sphere interativa
examples.why: The participle should agree with 'o estado' (it is the state that is shown, not the qubits).

editor_note: Both rewritten link labels are faithful and conventional: "dynamical decoupling" becomes "desacoplamento dinâmico", and "Pauli twirling" becomes "twirling de Pauli", which matches the page's own "twirling de gate" and "twirling de medição"; URLs are unchanged.

Entry 15 is faithful and does not mislead. Exclusive access, no other jobs including calibration jobs, the reduced per-job queuing delays and the cost function running locally all survive intact. Two small wording slips remain. "aproveitando o paralelismo da pilha" renders "stack" as the bare word "pilha", which a Portuguese reader may take for the stack data structure; Brazilian writers usually say "stack" or "pilha de software". "A função de custo na imagem representa a de um algoritmo…" copies the English sentence structure and reads stiffly.

examples.source: taking advantage of parallelism in the stack
examples.translation: aproveitando o paralelismo da pilha
examples.suggested: aproveitando o paralelismo da stack de software
examples.why: A bare 'pilha' is ambiguous and easily read as the data structure. In Brazilian technical writing, a software stack is usually called 'stack' or 'pilha de software'.

examples.source: The cost function in the image represents that of a quantum variational algorithm, running on a user's local machine.
examples.translation: A função de custo na imagem representa a de um algoritmo variacional quântico, executado na máquina local do usuário.
examples.suggested: A função de custo mostrada na imagem é a de um algoritmo variacional quântico, executada na máquina local do usuário.
examples.why: 'representa a de' copies the English structure and reads stiffly. Also, 'executado' agrees with 'algoritmo', but the English phrase 'running on a user's local machine' refers to the cost function.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The 28-day rolling window, the Flex Plan caveat, the choice of the instance with the least allocation used, and FIFO order within an instance all come through intact, and "escalonador de compartilhamento justo" is used consistently. A native editor would still smooth a few calques: "Com tudo mais sendo igual" in [11] and "O comprimento dessa janela" in [7]. In [14], "scheduling window" becomes "janela de agendamento" even though the rest of the page renders "schedule" with the escalonar family.

examples.source: With all else being equal, an instance with twice the number of minutes can execute twice the number of workloads.
examples.translation: Com tudo mais sendo igual, uma instância com o dobro de minutos pode executar o dobro de cargas de trabalho.
examples.suggested: Mantidas as demais condições, uma instância com o dobro de minutos pode executar o dobro de cargas de trabalho.
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of 'all else being equal'. Portuguese uses 'mantidas as demais condições' or 'em igualdade de condições'.

examples.source: The length of that window is currently 28 days.
examples.translation: O comprimento dessa janela é atualmente de 28 dias.
examples.suggested: A duração dessa janela é atualmente de 28 dias.
examples.why: 'Comprimento' means physical length. For a span of time, 'duração' is the natural word.

examples.source: ...used the least amount of their allocation within the current scheduling window.
examples.translation: ...dentro da janela de agendamento atual.
examples.suggested: ...dentro da janela de escalonamento atual.
examples.why: The page calls the scheduler 'escalonador', so 'scheduling window' should use 'escalonamento' too. 'Agendamento' breaks the term family, though the meaning stays clear.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the job-sizing numbers (11 PUBs x 1000 → about 11,000 instances; 100 x 200 = 20,000 shots), the caveat that estimator_options replaces the defaults entirely, and the per-job 6073 limit. Nothing here would mislead a learner. A native editor would still fix some stiffness and inconsistency. The inputs table header keeps English "Input" even though the section heading is "Entradas". [56] uses the calque "faz o transpile" where "transpila" is expected. [60] leaves the link text "Job limits" in English. [63] uses "remédio" where "solução" is the natural technical word.

examples.source: | Input | Default | Description |
examples.translation: | Input | Padrão | Descrição |
examples.suggested: | Entrada | Padrão | Descrição |
examples.why: The header is left in English although the section heading [37] and the prose use 'entradas'.

examples.source: transpiles and executes on a real IBM Quantum processor
examples.translation: faz o transpile e executa em um processador IBM Quantum real
examples.suggested: transpila e executa em um processador IBM Quantum real
examples.why: 'faz o transpile' is a calque. Portuguese Qiskit docs use the verb 'transpilar'.

examples.source: [Job limits](/guides/job-limits) gives the thresholds
examples.translation: [Job limits](/guides/job-limits) fornece os limites
examples.suggested: [Limites de jobs](/guides/job-limits) fornece os limites
examples.why: The link text is left in English, while other guide links on the page (e.g. 'Opções do Estimator') are translated.

examples.source: which is the remedy error 6073 itself suggests
examples.translation: o que é o remédio que o próprio erro 6073 sugere
examples.suggested: que é a solução sugerida pelo próprio erro 6073
examples.why: 'remédio' is a literal carry-over of 'remedy'. 'solução' reads more naturally in technical Portuguese.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. The meaning matches entry for entry, including the preview caveat, the ZNE/PEC comparisons, the HI-VQE figures ("1 kcal/mol, 1,6 mHa", "40 a 60 qubits", "respectivamente") and the tabu search / simulated annealing baselines. The problems are a few stiff renderings. "Quantum" is used as a bare noun in "integrando o quantum", "prontas para o quantum" and "profundo conhecimento em quantum", and "quantum-clássica" should be "quântico-clássica". "Multi-physics PDEs" became the awkward "PDEs de múltipla física" instead of the usual "EDPs multifísicas". For "unbiased expectation values", "imparciais" is recognizable, but the usual statistical term is "não enviesados".

examples.source: integrating quantum into existing large-scale classical workflows
examples.translation: integrando o quantum em fluxos de trabalho clássicos de grande escala já existentes
examples.suggested: integrando a computação quântica em fluxos de trabalho clássicos de grande escala já existentes
examples.why: Portuguese does not use 'o quantum' as a bare noun for quantum computing. It reads as a calque.

examples.source: Use quantum computation for multi-physics PDEs.
examples.translation: Use computação quântica para PDEs de múltipla física.
examples.suggested: Use computação quântica para EDPs multifísicas.
examples.why: 'Multifísica' and 'EDP' are the standard Portuguese terms. 'De múltipla física' is a literal calque.

examples.source: unbiased expectation values
examples.translation: valores esperados imparciais
examples.suggested: valores esperados não enviesados
examples.why: In statistics, 'unbiased' is usually rendered 'não enviesado'. 'Imparcial' is understandable but less precise here.

examples.source: hybrid quantum-classical optimization ... without deep quantum expertise
examples.translation: otimização híbrida quantum-clássica ... sem necessidade de profundo conhecimento em quantum
examples.suggested: otimização híbrida quântico-clássica ... sem necessidade de profundo conhecimento em computação quântica
examples.why: This mixes English 'quantum' into Portuguese compound adjectives and noun phrases. A native editor would use 'quântico-clássica' and 'computação quântica'.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries (5, 6, 26) keep the English meaning. The admonitions keep "client-side vs server-side", "largely drop-in" and "only the import statement changes", and the recommendation links point to the right targets. The problems are stylistic. In entry 6, "com a única mudança sendo a instrução de importação" is a calque of the English "with the only change being". Entry 5 drops the hyphen in "pré e pós-processamento", which should be "pré- e pós-processamento". Entry 26 uses "Aprenda como" twice where natural Portuguese is "Aprenda a".

examples.source: with the only change being the import statement
examples.translation: com a única mudança sendo a instrução de importação
examples.suggested: bastando alterar apenas a instrução de importação
examples.why: This is a calque of the English construction. It is stiff in Portuguese technical prose.

examples.source: most of the pre- and post-processing
examples.translation: a maior parte do pré e pós-processamento
examples.suggested: a maior parte do pré- e pós-processamento
examples.why: The hyphen is missing in "pré-". Portuguese writes a shared prefix with a hyphen.

examples.source: Learn how to test locally / Learn how to transpile locally
examples.translation: Aprenda como testar localmente / Aprenda como transpilar localmente
examples.suggested: Aprenda a testar localmente / Aprenda a transpilar localmente
examples.why: "Aprenda como" + infinitive copies the English "learn how to". The idiomatic form is "aprenda a".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful everywhere and nothing would mislead a learner. The three-zone and no-single-point-of-failure claims, the note that customers are not responsible for disaster recovery, and the SLO/SLA references all carry over correctly. Two small wording issues remain. In [9], "Se um nó ou zona de instância HA falhar" regroups "an HA instance node or zone" so that "zona de instância HA" becomes a phrase of its own, and "Nenhuma degradação perceptível do serviço ocorre" copies the English word order. A native editor would write "Se um nó de instância HA ou uma zona falhar" and "Não ocorre degradação perceptível do serviço".

examples.source: If an HA instance node or zone fails, the service continues to run API requests through to the surviving HA instance nodes.
examples.translation: Se um nó ou zona de instância HA falhar, o serviço continua a processar as requisições de API pelos nós de instância HA restantes.
examples.suggested: Se um nó de instância HA ou uma zona falhar, o serviço continua a processar as requisições de API pelos nós de instância HA restantes.
examples.why: The regrouping makes 'de instância HA' look like it modifies 'zona' too, which reads awkwardly and is slightly ambiguous.

examples.source: No noticeable degradation of service occurs during a zonal failure.
examples.translation: Nenhuma degradação perceptível do serviço ocorre durante uma falha zonal.
examples.suggested: Não ocorre degradação perceptível do serviço durante uma falha de zona.
examples.why: It copies the English 'No X occurs' pattern word for word. Portuguese normally puts the negated verb first.

editor_note: Entry 9 is faithful and reads naturally: "se você habilitar o Pauli-twirling no seu job do Sampler, o número total de shots é baseado nos valores de `num_randomizations` e `shots_per_randomization`" keeps the condition and the caveat intact, and uses job/shots/Sampler the same way as the rest of the page.

The translation is faithful throughout and would not mislead a learner. Compatibility statements ([10], [35]), the underscore-vs-hyphen note ([28]) and the Pauli-Lindblad/TREX caveat ([38]) all keep their meaning. The one thing a native editor would change is in [37], where "the learner" becomes "aprendiz". In Portuguese that word reads as "apprentice", not as the software component. Terms are otherwise used consistently: "primitiva", "do lado do cliente/servidor", "caixas anotadas", "aprendizado de ruído" and "você".

examples.source: The noise maps returned by the learner are positionally matched to those layers
examples.translation: Os mapas de ruído retornados pelo aprendiz são correspondidos posicionalmente a essas camadas
examples.suggested: Os mapas de ruído retornados pelo NoiseLearnerV3 correspondem posicionalmente a essas camadas
examples.why: 'aprendiz' means apprentice and reads as a literal calque of 'learner'. Naming the class (or keeping 'learner') is clearer, and 'correspondem' is less stiff than the passive 'são correspondidos'.

editor_note: Rewritten entry 19 is faithful and reads naturally in Portuguese. It keeps the caveat that the `(input_dim, output_dim)` tuple "é o inverso da forma da matriz subjacente", uses "propriedade `Operator.dim`" and the casual "você" register.

The rewritten entry [8], "O código nesta página foi desenvolvido usando os seguintes requisitos. Recomendamos usar essas versões ou mais recentes.", says exactly what the English says, keeps the "these versions or newer" recommendation and the line break, and reads naturally.
Entry 6 is correct: "Package versions" becomes "Versões dos pacotes", which is faithful and idiomatic, and the Accordion markup is unchanged.

Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. Entry 18 renders "for full details about the class" as "para obter detalhes completos sobre a classe". Entry 25 keeps the negated condition exactly ("não precisa ser instanciada se você estiver definindo opções após inicializar a primitiva") and uses the same feminine "a primitiva" as the rest of the page.

None of the 12 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The shots-precedence entries (16, 18, 21) keep the meaning, including "têm precedência sobre quaisquer valores especificados como opções" and the twirling product condition. The fixes are all phrasing. The link label "Documentação de API de `x`" is a stiff calque with a doubled "de" and repeats in entries 33, 36, 50, 58, 69, 72 and 84; a native writer would use "Documentação da API de `x`". Entry 105 has the clumsy echo "modo de execução executar seu job". Entry 73 labels "Choices" as "**Opções**", which on an options page reads like "options"; "Valores possíveis" would be clearer, though the page uses "Opções" for "Choices" consistently.

examples.source: [`default_shots` API documentation](...)
examples.translation: [Documentação de API de `default_shots`](...)
examples.suggested: [Documentação da API de `default_shots`](...)
examples.why: 'de API de' is a calque with an awkward doubled preposition; the natural PT form is 'da API'. The same pattern appears in entries 36, 50, 58, 69, 72 and 84.

examples.source: Decide what [execution mode](execution-modes) to run your job in.
examples.translation: Decida em qual [modo de execução](execution-modes) executar seu job.
examples.suggested: Decida em qual [modo de execução](execution-modes) rodar seu job.
examples.why: 'execução executar' is a clumsy repetition that a native technical writer would avoid.

examples.source: **Choices**: List of basis gate names to unroll to
examples.translation: **Opções**: Lista de nomes de gates base para os quais o circuito será decomposto
examples.suggested: **Valores possíveis**: Lista de nomes de gates base para os quais o circuito será decomposto
examples.why: On a page about options, 'Opções' for 'Choices' blurs the difference between the option and its allowed values. The label is used consistently across the page, so this is minor.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The plan-specific usage windows are kept exactly: 28 days rolling as "período móvel" for Premium/Open, usage since creation for Pay-As-You-Go, and usage since the start of the contract for Flex. Two small fluency slips remain. Entry [5] joins two imperatives with only a comma ("acesse a página de Instâncias, clique na instância"), which reads as a comma splice. Entry [6] uses the anglicism "reporta" where a Brazilian technical writer would write "mostra" or "informa".

examples.source: from the [Instances page](...), click the instance to open its details page.
examples.translation: acesse a [página de Instâncias](...), clique na instância para abrir a página de detalhes.
examples.suggested: acesse a [página de Instâncias](...) e clique na instância para abrir a página de detalhes.
examples.why: Two imperatives joined only by a comma form a comma splice. Adding 'e' makes the steps read naturally.

examples.source: **Instance usage** reports a different value, depending on the type of plan
examples.translation: **Uso da instância** reporta um valor diferente dependendo do tipo de plano
examples.suggested: **Uso da instância** mostra um valor diferente, dependendo do tipo de plano
examples.why: 'Reporta' is a calque of 'reports'. 'Mostra' or 'informa' is the idiomatic verb for what a UI field displays.

editor_note: Entry 67 keeps the three-way break-even logic intact: 'menor que esse ponto de equilíbrio… o código ajuda', 'estaríamos apenas desperdiçando tempo e mais 8 qubits', and 'não deveríamos de forma alguma usar este código, pois ele está *aumentando* a chance de um erro lógico'. The Portuguese reads naturally.

The meaning is faithful all the way through. The key caveats survive, including 'desde que o nível de ruído fique abaixo de um certo valor limiar' and the emphasised 'ele *não* depende do tamanho do circuito', so nothing here would mislead a learner. The one editorial problem is that 'gate' has two renderings in the file: 'gates' (English) in entries [2]-[4], then 'portas' in [6]-[7], and it should be unified. 'magic states' is also left in English in [6], where 'estados mágicos' is the usual Portuguese term.

examples.source: we'll discuss *transversal* implementations of gates
examples.translation: discutiremos implementações *transversais* de portas
examples.suggested: Use one rendering for 'gate' across the file: either 'portas' everywhere, or 'gates' as in [2]-[4]
examples.why: Entries [2], [3] and [4] say 'gates quânticos' or 'gates', but [6] and [7] switch to 'portas', which gives the same concept two names.

examples.source: so-called *magic states*
examples.translation: os chamados *magic states*
examples.suggested: os chamados *estados mágicos*
examples.why: The term is left in English inside Portuguese prose, while 'estados mágicos' is the established Portuguese rendering and fits the surrounding text.

editor_note: Entry 17 matches the English notice clause for clause. It keeps every detail: Credly as "processador de dados terceirizado" located "nos Estados Unidos", the shared data "(nome, endereço de e-mail e badge conquistado)", "pode compartilhar" preserving the "may", and the "badge" rendering is consistent with entries 12 and 14. The one cosmetic quirk is that the final period moved inside the link text ("[aqui.]"), which does not affect meaning.

The meaning is faithful and nothing here would mislead a learner. The core terms are correct and consistent: formalismo estabilizador, códigos estabilizadores, observáveis, produtos tensoriais, código de repetição. The register is casual "você" throughout. The one thing a native editor would change is "código Shor de 9 qubits" (entry 2, twice), which copies English word order. Portuguese sources name the code after the person: "código de Shor de 9 qubits".

examples.source: focusing specifically on the 9-qubit Shor code
examples.translation: com foco no código Shor de 9 qubits
examples.suggested: com foco no código de Shor de 9 qubits
examples.why: Portuguese names an eponymous code with 'de' (código de Shor, algoritmo de Shor). 'código Shor' copies the English noun-adjunct order. The same fix applies at line 3 of the entry.

editor_note: Entry 71 is faithful and natural. The double-angle formula block is kept verbatim, and "Em resumo, o estado do registrador $\mathsf{Q}$ no início do passo 2 é" matches the English and uses the same terms as the rest of the file (registrador, passo 2).

The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The quadratic/square-root relationship, the caveat about near-term practicality and the FFT/quicksort comparison all come through intact. A few phrases read as calques. In [5], "parece improvável de gerar" is non-idiomatic ("parece improvável que gere" is better), and "vantagem ... do quantum sobre a computação clássica" is an awkward nominalization. In [6], "ainda esteja muito em seu estágio inicial" and "não devemos ser tão rápidos em subestimar" follow the English wording too closely.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful and nothing here would mislead a learner. editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the subtle GHZ accidental-protection argument in [137]-[152], so nothing here would mislead a learner. editor_note: The page is faithful and natural overall, with correct terms throughout ("supressão, mitigação, detecção e correção de erros quânticos", "vantagem quântica", "quais entram em conflito"). editor_note: I found no meaning drift that would mislead a learner. The pedagogy holds throughout, including the dephasing p→1 subtlety, the ZZ-commutation argument and the CNOT propagation table. The problems are term inconsistencies within the file. 'Energy relaxation' is 'relaxação de energia' in the T1 section [46-72] but 'relaxamento de energia' from [110] on. 'Dephasing' is 'desfasagem'/'canal completamente desfasador' in [165,174] but 'defasagem' from [211] on. Crosstalk, shaded light cones and workflow each switch between English and Portuguese forms. There are also a few leftover English strings and calques. '__Kraus representations__ são' [169] was left in English. [265] contains a garbled clause, 'se E ocorrer logo antes do acoplamento ZZ for o mesmo que agir depois'. [34] uses the calque 'empurrando contra esses limites'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the fidelity crossover discussion in [95]-[101], and nothing would mislead a learner. There are a few terminology and naturalness slips. "Expectation value" is translated two ways: "valores esperados" in [48] and the calque "valores de expectativa" in [64], [68], [70]-[72]. editor_note: I found no misleading passages. The weak-coupling approximations, the differential meson-minus-vacuum protocol and the atol trade-off all mean the same as the English, and the core terms are correct and consistent (hamiltoniano, teoria de calibre de rede, sítios/elos, portas de dois qubits, valores esperados). A native editor would still fix three things. [0] says "hardware quântico do IBM", but IBM takes the feminine article ("da IBM"). [48] renders "layering" as "sobrepondo", which suggests overlapping or superposition rather than stacking layers. [81]/[82] use "limite de truncamento" for "truncation threshold", which is easy to confuse with the physics sense of "limite" (limit) used in [20]; "limiar" would be clearer.

examples.source: on IBM quantum hardware
examples.translation: em hardware quântico do IBM
examples.suggested: em hardware quântico da IBM
examples.why: IBM takes the feminine article in Portuguese (a IBM).

examples.source: layering interaction, electric, and mass terms with SWAP gates
examples.translation: sobrepondo os termos de interação, elétrico e de massa com portas SWAP
examples.suggested: dispondo em camadas os termos de interação, elétrico e de massa, com portas SWAP
examples.why: 'sobrepondo' reads as overlapping or superimposing, which is misleading wording in a quantum context. The English means stacking the terms in successive layers.

examples.source: The trade-off is a small, controllable approximation error that you can validate by comparing results at different thresholds.
examples.translation: O trade-off é um erro de aproximação pequeno e controlável, que você pode validar comparando resultados em diferentes limites.
examples.suggested: A contrapartida é um erro de aproximação pequeno e controlável, que você pode validar comparando resultados com diferentes limiares.
examples.why: 'limite' also means 'limit' (as in the continuum limit in [20]). 'limiar' is the clearer term for a threshold, and the English 'trade-off' can be translated naturally as 'contrapartida'.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, including the tricky parts: the variational-bound argument, the M_J-on-products reasoning and the first-order-angle appendix. I found no drift that would mislead a learner. The main slip is the table in entry 39, which keeps English number separators ("4,000", "1,963,461"), while the prose correctly uses "4.000" and "1.963.461"; to a Portuguese reader "4,000" reads as four. There are also a few gender and agreement errors ("das duas meio-registradoras", "algumas poucas milhares"). Some terms are rendered two ways: "pairing" appears as both "emparelhamento" and "pareamento", and "Diagonalização quântica baseada em amostragem" appears once as "baseada em amostras de um Hamiltoniano de química". "Recoupling" is left in English, where "recoplamento" is the usual term, and "autossolucionador" is an awkward coinage.

examples.why: In Portuguese a comma is the decimal separator, so '4,000' reads as 4. Entries 120, 121 and 126 already use the dot separator, so the table should match.

examples.source: repair the two half-register nucleon numbers
examples.translation: repara os números de núcleons das duas meio-registradoras
examples.suggested: repara os números de núcleons das duas metades do registrador
examples.why: 'Registrador' is masculine, so 'meio-registradoras' is ungrammatical. Entry 30 already uses 'metades do registrador'.

examples.source: a few thousand bitstrings can span
examples.translation: algumas poucas milhares de bitstrings
examples.suggested: alguns poucos milhares de bitstrings
examples.why: 'Milhar' is masculine, so this is an agreement error.

examples.source: the pairing interaction strongly prefers
examples.translation: a interação de pareamento prefere fortemente
examples.suggested: a interação de emparelhamento prefere fortemente
examples.why: Entry 64 renders the 'pairing force' as 'força de emparelhamento'. The same term should be used in both places.

examples.source: an iterative eigensolver such as
examples.translation: um autossolucionador iterativo como o
examples.suggested: um solucionador de autovalores iterativo, como o

editor_note: Entry 9 is faithful and reads naturally. It renders the prerequisite as "Usar a primitiva Estimator para calcular valores esperados de um observável", with "valores esperados" and "observável" matching the rest of the page.

The translation is faithful and reads naturally, with the physics terms used correctly and consistently: "vidros de spin", "frustração", "estado fundamental", "NP-difícil", "força de acoplamento", "paisagem de energia 'acidentada'" and "portas de dois qubits".

The meaning is faithful throughout, including the last 40%: the bias and overhead figures (γ² ≈ 1.6×10², a further ~3.4-fold reduction to ≈48, a 10% band), the "PEC puro é, em princípio, não enviesado" caveat and the safe-timeout reasoning are all correct. The problems are terminology splits and a few calques. "shaded lightcones" appears both as "lightcones sombreados" ([0], [7]) and as English "shaded lightcones" ([17], [47]). "shade" is "sombra" in [17] but "shades" in [86], and "overhead" becomes "sobrecarga" once in [86]. There is also a calque ("prependemos", [58]), "unique layers" is rendered as the ambiguous "camadas únicas", and [155] has an agreement error ("mitigação ... aceleradas").

examples.source: Shaded lightcones (SLC) go further ... each potential error in the circuit is assigned a graded "shade"
examples.translation: Os shaded lightcones (SLC) vão além ... recebe uma "sombra" graduada
examples.suggested: Os lightcones sombreados (SLC) vão além ... (and use 'sombras' again in [86] instead of 'shades')
examples.why: This entry leaves 'shaded lightcones' in English, while [0] and [7] translate it as 'lightcones sombreados'. [86] then switches 'sombra' to the English 'shades'.

examples.source: tightens the bounds and further reduces the sampling overhead
examples.translation: torna os limites mais precisos e reduz ainda mais a sobrecarga de amostragem
examples.suggested: torna os limites mais precisos e reduz ainda mais o overhead de amostragem
examples.why: Everywhere else the file uses 'overhead de amostragem'. This is the only place it switches to 'sobrecarga'.

examples.source: we prepend the corresponding basis-preparation gates at the start of the mirror circuit
examples.translation: prependemos os gates correspondentes de preparação de base no início do circuito espelhado
examples.suggested: inserimos os gates correspondentes de preparação de base no início do circuito espelhado
examples.why: 'prependemos' is a calque of 'prepend' and is not a standard Portuguese verb.

examples.source: a user learns the noise of unique layers in a circuit
examples.translation: um usuário aprende o ruído de camadas únicas em um circuito
examples.suggested: um usuário aprende o ruído das camadas distintas de um circuito
examples.why: 'camadas únicas' can be read as 'single layers'. 'distintas' makes clear the meaning is 'each distinct layer type'.

examples.source: Lightcone shading for classically accelerated quantum error mitigation
examples.translation: Lightcone shading para mitigação de erros quânticos aceleradas classicamente
examples.suggested: Lightcone shading para mitigação de erros quânticos acelerada classicamente
examples.why: 'acelerada' has to agree with the feminine singular 'mitigação'.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, so nothing here would mislead a learner. That includes the tricky passages on Clifford-angle difficulty [65], non-monotonic accuracy [118]/[119] and the device-dependent ordering of the noise rates [108]. A native editor would still fix a few slips. There is a gender-agreement error, "como na cancelamento probabilístico" [28], and an ungrammatical relative clause, "Essa estrutura é o que as etapas ... dependem" [77]. Terms also drift late in the file: "gate" replaces "porta" in [149], and "randomizados/randomizações" replaces the file's usual "aleatorizados/aleatorizações" in [138] and [150].

examples.source: as in probabilistic error cancellation (PEC)
examples.translation: como na cancelamento probabilístico de erros (PEC)
examples.suggested: como no cancelamento probabilístico de erros (PEC)
examples.why: Gender-agreement error: 'cancelamento' is masculine.

examples.source: That structure is what the boxing and noise-learning steps rely on
examples.translation: Essa estrutura é o que as etapas de encaixotamento e aprendizado de ruído dependem
examples.suggested: É dessa estrutura que dependem as etapas de encaixotamento e aprendizado de ruído
examples.why: The sentence is missing the preposition 'de' that 'depender' requires. It is an English calque and reads as ungrammatical.

examples.source: compensates for two-qubit gate errors
examples.translation: compensa efetivamente os erros de gate de dois qubits
examples.suggested: compensa efetivamente os erros de porta de dois qubits
examples.why: Everywhere else the file renders 'gate' as 'porta'. Here the English word slips in.

examples.source: sampling imbalance in the randomized circuits
examples.translation: desequilíbrio de amostragem nos circuitos randomizados
examples.suggested: desequilíbrio de amostragem nos circuitos aleatorizados
examples.why: The file uses 'aleatorizados/aleatorizações' elsewhere but switches to 'randomizados' here and 'randomizações' in [138].

examples.source: Enables edge-based post-selection
examples.translation: Habilita a pós-seleção baseada em bordas
examples.suggested: Habilita a pós-seleção baseada em arestas
examples.why: 'Edge' here means an edge of the qubit coupling graph. 'Arestas' is the graph-theory term; 'bordas' suggests a boundary.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the last 40%. The caveats are kept: MEM is applied only to dynamic/orbit and cannot change mid-circuit results already used by feedforward ([50]), the no-DD caveat in [43], and the Figure 2a caveats in [55]. Core terms stay consistent: medição no meio do circuito, desacoplamento dinâmico, fidelidade de processo, transpilar/transpiler, and você throughout. Two things a native editor would still change. First, Qiskit's `stretch` concept is translated as "estiramento" ([60], [65]), which hides its link to the `stretch` keyword and the guide. Second, "preservar o tempo de QPU" in [19] is a calque; "economizar" is the natural word.

examples.source: If you encounter negative stretch values [[3]](#references), try a smaller (fewer pulse) DD sequence.
examples.translation: Se você encontrar valores de estiramento negativos [[3]](#references), tente uma sequência de DD menor (com menos pulsos).
examples.suggested: Se você encontrar valores negativos de stretch [[3]](#references), tente uma sequência de DD menor (com menos pulsos).
examples.why: `stretch` is a named Qiskit/OpenQASM timing construct. Translating it as "estiramento" hides the link to the keyword and to the linked guide.

examples.source: Quantum Compute limitations for stretch variables
examples.translation: Limitações do Quantum Compute para variáveis de estiramento
examples.suggested: Limitações do Quantum Compute para variáveis stretch
examples.why: Same over-translation of the `stretch` construct, here in the reference title.

examples.source: with a smaller 1024-shot count to preserve QPU time
examples.translation: com uma contagem menor de 1024 shots para preservar o tempo de QPU
examples.suggested: com uma contagem menor de 1024 shots para economizar tempo de QPU
examples.why: "Preservar" is a calque of "preserve". In Portuguese, you "economizar" (save) a resource.

editor_note: Entry 10 is faithful and reads naturally. It keeps "ligação Li–S se rompe", "visão em nível molecular" and "superfícies de energia potencial são ferramentas para estudar caminhos de reação e catalisadores" without softening or adding anything.

None of the nine rewritten entries changes the meaning. The caveats in [16], [44], [76], [77] and [88] survive intact, including the stale-information warning, the fact that a synthetic noise model only gives back the numbers you put in, and the point that a gap is "não é automaticamente evidência de deriva". The problems are consistency ones. "Gate" is feminine in [44] ("suas gates") but masculine in [57] ("gates nativos"). [44] keeps "Qiskit pattern" in English, while [30] and [31] use "padrão Qiskit". The tutorial title is translated as "Benchmarking em tempo real para seleção de qubits" in [16] but left in English in [92].

examples.source: how often its gates and readout fail ... the four steps of a Qiskit pattern
examples.translation: com que frequência suas gates e leituras falham ... as quatro etapas de um Qiskit pattern
examples.suggested: com que frequência seus gates e leituras falham ... as quatro etapas de um padrão Qiskit
examples.why: 'Gate' is masculine in [57] ('gates nativos') and feminine here. [30] and [31] translate 'Qiskit pattern' as 'padrão Qiskit', but here it is left in English.

examples.source: [Real-time benchmarking for qubit selection](/tutorials/real-time-benchmarking-for-qubit-selection) tutorial
examples.translation: tutorial [Real-time benchmarking for qubit selection](...)
examples.suggested: tutorial [Benchmarking em tempo real para seleção de qubits](...)
examples.why: [16] translates the same tutorial title into Portuguese, but here it stays in English. Readers see two different names for the same link.

examples.source: which makes them well suited for comparing qubits
examples.translation: o que os torna adequados para comparar qubits
examples.suggested: o que os torna bastante adequados para comparar qubits
examples.why: The intensifier 'well' is dropped, so the claim is slightly weaker. This is small and does not mislead.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the last 40%. The upper-bound guarantee in [61], the sparsity condition in [29] and the "first iteration already close" caveat in [58] all match the English. Entry [33] renders "gate" as "portão", which means a physical gate like a garden gate; the conventional Portuguese term is "porta", and the file itself uses "conjunto de portas" in [51]. The step headings are also inconsistent: Steps 1-3 use "Passo", but [56] switches to "Etapa 4". There is also a small grammar slip in [29], where "isto é, tem peso" should use the subjunctive, "tenha peso".

examples.source: amounts to a single CPhase gate between the spin-up and spin-down orbitals
examples.translation: equivale a um único portão [CPhase] entre os orbitais
examples.suggested: equivale a uma única porta [CPhase] entre os orbitais
examples.why: 'Portão' is a literal but wrong word for gate. The field uses 'porta', and so does [51] in this same file.

examples.source: Step 4: Post-process and return result to desired classical format
examples.translation: Etapa 4: Pós-processar e retornar o resultado no formato clássico desejado
examples.suggested: Passo 4: Pós-processar e retornar o resultado no formato clássico desejado
examples.why: Steps 1-3 are headed 'Passo'. Switching to 'Etapa' for step 4 breaks the parallel structure of the workflow.

examples.source: guaranteed only if the ground state is sparse, that is, it has significant weight
examples.translation: garantido apenas se o estado fundamental for esparso, isto é, tem peso significativo
examples.suggested: garantido apenas se o estado fundamental for esparso, isto é, se tiver peso significativo
examples.why: The clause still belongs to the condition, so it needs the subjunctive. The indicative 'tem' reads as a calque.

editor_note: All five rewritten entries match their English: the zig-zag heavy-hex mapping in [27] ("a cada 4º orbital espacial… qubit ancilla"), the scoring heuristic and warning caveat in [51] ("Se nem todos os pares puderem ser implementados, ela emite um aviso"), and the three hardware changes in [66] ("heavy-hex para o Heron, quadrada para o Nighthawk") all read naturally, and ansatz, gates and gerenciador de passes are used the same way throughout the page.

Entry 79 is faithful and natural ("Curso [...] da IBM Quantum, pelo Dr. John Watrous"). Keeping the course title in English matches the other reference entries (78, 80-86), which also keep their original titles, so it is a defensible choice even though the running prose (entries 9, 15, 23) says "Fundamentos de algoritmos quânticos".
